newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Wolters raises div payout ratio to 35 pct.
newsitem.headline: Wolters raises div payout ratio to 35 pct.

text.p: Publisher Wolters Kluwer NV said on Friday it was raising its dividend payout ratio to about 35 percent from just over 30 percent in recent years.
"For some years now, a payout ratio of just over 30 percent has been maintained, but from 1996 onwards the intention is to increase this to approximately 35 percent," the company said.
"In view of the increasingly international spread of our shareholders, this higher structural level is more in line with current international expectations," it added.
